# Astronomical 0.2.63
## What's new
- Persistent prompt-cache restoration for Qwen3.5, K2 Horizon MoVA, and Laguna now loads, evaluates, and releases one source block at a time into a final-size destination, reducing peak memory during cache hits. - Laguna cache-hit admission now budgets for one restore block or boundary snapshot instead of the complete restored prefix. - Unused Rust dependencies were removed from runtime and test dependency graphs without changing application behavior.
## Compatibility
No REST API, configuration, model artifact, or prompt-cache format change is intended. Existing model files, user settings, and saved prompt-cache data remain in place.
## Distribution
The macOS disk image is Developer ID signed and notarized, and the Sparkle update feed is signed.
